changes.summary: Fixed anchor build (dep pins) and ran validator tests: 14/14 unit + 10/10 integration pass.
changes.details: Root cause: anchor build uses Solana platform-tools cargo 1.84, which cannot parse edition2024 crates. Pinned in Cargo.lock: zeroize 1.8.1->1.7.0, zeroize_derive 1.5.0->1.4.2, borsh 1.8.1->1.5.5 (derive ->1.5.7), proc-macro-crate 3.5.0->3.2.0, indexmap 2.14.2->2.9.0, unicode-segmentation 1.13.3->1.12.0. Regenerated program id (old keypair was gitignored/lost): declare_id + Anchor.toml now 3vRrCG5RnmrpTAr91rq9NnZqKCPgaDCmpEWKRLUTdqnH. anchor build OK (hook.so 288KB). cargo test -p hook 14/14 pass. tests/hook.ts 10/10 pass on solana-test-validator 2.3.0. NOTE: plain `anchor test` is broken on Node 26 (mocha 9 / yargs ESM error); workaround used: deploy with `solana program deploy` then `bun ./node_modules/.bin/mocha -t 1000000 --require ts-node/register tests/hook.ts` with ANCHOR_PROVIDER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8899.

changes.summary: CRITICAL: exact-bet hook makes graduation mathematically impossible (tail trap).
changes.details: Tiny pool stuck at reserve 2.438/2.581 SOL: ExactOut 12.5k and 10k quote FAIL (Not enough liquidity), 5k OK — remaining buyable is 5-10k tokens, unbuyable with == 12.5k bets. Main pool same disease: buyable = 767432058990588 raw (767,432,058.99 tokens), buyable % 12.5k = 7058990588 raw (~7,059 tokens tail). So main pool can NEVER graduate either — not 'almost unreachable' (docs 3/7.6) but literally unreachable. Funds not locked (sells always work). Options: (a) switch hook to <= (one-line + tests; tail becomes buyable, fomo ExactIn UX fixed too — docs 7.1 already recommended); (b) keep == and calibrate supply so buyable % bet == 0 (fragile); (c) accept permanent lock explicitly. Graduation mechanics test needs either (a) or a calibrated tiny pool #2.
changes.next: User decision: == vs <= vs accept-lock. Then either redeploy hook with <= or spin calibrated tiny pool #2.

changes.summary: Legacy fallback was broken (discriminator trap); fixed with manual parse. Lesson logged.
changes.details: First fallback used a second Anchor struct (HookConfigLegacy) — but Anchor types get distinct discriminators, so real old PDAs (HookConfig discriminator, 105 bytes) failed deser -> WrongConfig -> old pools bricked (caught on devnet pool #1 buy: 0x1773 WrongConfig). Fixed: manual field parse, same discriminator, lock tail defaults to 0. Legacy unit test rewritten to truncate real HookConfig bytes (faithful old-PDA simulation). 20/20 unit + 13/13 integration pass. Deployed binary grew 288448->293280 bytes; programdata extended +50000. Mainnet lesson stands and is now proven: finalize logic before mainnet, upgrades after pools exist are dangerous.

changes.summary: Hook reads POST-transfer balances: tiers/tail/hold now evaluate on reconstructed pre-values. 20/20 + 14/14.
changes.details: Token-2022 debits/credits BEFORE the hook CPI (verified in spl-token-2022 6.0.0 processor.rs + live logs: hook saw post-debit vault). Old code judged tiers on post values -> street-boundary buys would revert + tail rule could never pass (take-the-rest observed as lock). Fix: pre = post + amount (buys) / post - amount (sells); tier + tail on pre; hold checks observed (post-credit) dest balance directly. Unit fixtures now encode POST vaults (TAIL 100k/106k/94.5k/119.5k), over-hold dst = cap + bet. Integration: 4 tail ctxs + over-hold funded 250k (direct call sees pre balances). Docs 1.4 corrected.
